facts.business: Bayer CropScience Limited is dedicated to empowering smallholder farmers by providing access to cutting-edge innovations and sustainable agricultural practices, including crop protection solutions, digital tools, and regenerative agriculture.
key_risks: Geopolitical developments leading to increases in raw material and logistics costs and supply planning disruptions
Elevated fertilizer and input costs influencing farmer affordability and moderating demand
Inventory levels and competitive landscape affecting pricing dynamics
Potential El Niño conditions causing warmer and drier weather patterns, variability in crop cycles, pest incidence, and overall agri-input demand
